title: Can I En Passant Checkmate Martin?
summary: 'The video ends when I get en passant checkmate on Martin.' He keeps one Martin pawn on its 7th rank (a 'dream pawn' on the b-file, fixed with a bishop on b6), his own pawn on the 5th rank, removes Martin's pieces, promotes, boxes Martin's king near a8/a7 with knight Nb6 and queen, then waits for Martin to play ...b5 (if ...b6 instead, the run fails). Martin plays b5 and axb6 e.p. is checkmate - on the first recording.
rules: Goal: deliver checkmate with an en passant capture; any other result means restart the run.
If the needed enemy pawn moves only one square instead of two, the en passant mate is impossible and the run is over (6:50 'if B6 the run is over and I have to restart').
